lessons.name: Every claim in the report carries one of TWO honest verdicts — VERIFIED (it cites a checkable source or proof) or UNVERIFIED (held open) — the same binary uuidna's trial gives: an unverified claim is never asserted as fact and never called false, it is reported AS unverified, or held until a source confirms it.
lessons.why: Every claim in the report carries one of TWO honest verdicts — VERIFIED (it cites a checkable source or proof) or UNVERIFIED (held open) — the same binary uuidna's trial gives: an unverified claim is never asserted as fact and never called false, it is reported AS unverified, or held until a source confirms it.

lessons.name: A report ships only when verified AND trinity-audited AND quorate — the AND of the three, so any one failing blocks it: (true∧true∧true) publishes, (true∧true∧false) does not. The same audit-before-publish uuidna runs on its own notes.
lessons.why: A report ships only when verified AND trinity-audited AND quorate — the AND of the three, so any one failing blocks it: (true∧true∧true) publishes, (true∧true∧false) does not. The same audit-before-publish uuidna runs on its own notes.
lessons.statement: ((true && true && true) = true) ∧ ((true && true && false) = false)

lessons.name: A complete report answers SIX questions — who, what, when, where, why, and how: the five W's plus the one H, 5 + 1 = 6. Miss one and the story has a hole a reader can fall through.
lessons.why: A complete report answers SIX questions — who, what, when, where, why, and how: the five W's plus the one H, 5 + 1 = 6. Miss one and the story has a hole a reader can fall through.

lessons.name: A confirmed timeline is ORDERED in time — the events run 0,1,2,3,4,5, strictly ascending, each after the last. Diving deep means confirming the sequence.
lessons.why: A confirmed timeline is ORDERED in time — the events run 0,1,2,3,4,5, strictly ascending, each after the last. Diving deep means confirming the sequence.

lessons.name: Trinity editing is THREE independent passes — reporter, editor, and a third check — 1 + 1 + 1 = 3, the same trinity the ledger folds in. One writer's certainty is not an edit; three eyes catch what one misses.
lessons.why: Trinity editing is THREE independent passes — reporter, editor, and a third check — 1 + 1 + 1 = 3, the same trinity the ledger folds in. One writer's certainty is not an edit; three eyes catch what one misses.

lessons.name: Full quorum on a trinity is unanimity — all three agree (2 + 1 = 3) — and even a majority is two against one (2 > 1). Publication waits for the quorum; a split is a story still being reported.
lessons.why: Full quorum on a trinity is unanimity — all three agree (2 + 1 = 3) — and even a majority is two against one (2 > 1). Publication waits for the quorum; a split is a story still being reported.

lessons.name: The inverted pyramid puts the most vital fact first and descends — importance 5,4,3,2,1 — so a reader who stops early still has the heart of it, and an editor can cut from the bottom without losing the lede.
